steps.en: Install the server; configure chain, funded wallet and mining policy
steps.zh: 安装服务，配置链、注资钱包与计算策略

steps.en: Load configured modules and expose the recipient page
steps.zh: 加载配置模块，提供领取网页

component.zh: 模块加载器与网页服务

steps.en: Have a recipient enter an address and complete browser mining
steps.zh: 让领取者填地址并完成浏览器计算

steps.en: Release the mining block so the session can proceed
steps.zh: 解除计算阻塞，让会话继续

steps.en: Have the recipient claim the qualified reward
steps.zh: 让领取者申领已取得资格的奖励

steps.en: Check claim state and limits, then queue a funded-wallet transfer
steps.zh: 检查领取状态与额度，排队从注资钱包转账

value.en: Qualified recipients reach a controlled payout queue, not an unrestricted address form
value.zh: 合格领取者进入受控转账队列，不再任意填地址领币
